column1: Welcome to the Viscose Benches! Here are some things you should know:

column2: • To use this sheet: in the top left, click File → Make a Copy.

• I picked out scenarios that I personally found the most helpful for ingame translation and technique improvement. While they are in benchmark form, this is more of a practice playlist disguised as a benchmark. That's why there are such a large number of scenarios and why some categories are underrepresented.

• One of the issues I tried to address with these benches is how going between Intermediate and Advanced can feel like a huge jump. To fix this, I have added additional ranks in each difficulty, and left some overlap between them with the intent that people play two sets of benchmarks simultaneously to vary their focus. I'd recommend beginner players try intermediate if they can comfortable get mammoth scores, and players on the intermediate benchmarks try advanced once they are around lavender/indigo.
• In order to get a rank, you need to get at least one score in each subcategory. It's hard and it takes forever to get a rank, but I want to push people to be well rounded.

• The number next to each scenario is your accumulated threads. The closer you are to the top score requirement on a given scenario, the more threads you receive. This gives you a look at the overall strength of your scoresheet, but doesn't actually affect your rank. Your total threads is summed at the top.
• Currently, the score targets are prospective. On each difficulty, we have a link in the top right to a feedback form. Please send your sheets and opinions so we can balance these targets!

• For categories like Arm, Wrist, and Fingertips, these scenarios are categorized by what muscle group I think they stress the most. These classifications can break at certain sensitivities, but I found these scenarios to target those particular muscle groups very effectively in practice. Scores slower than 50cm on fingertip scenarios are invalid, and 103hfov is the minimum for all scenarios.
• If you click any scenario name, I have left a comment that tells you how to get the most out of each scenario and what to focus on while you practice. (WIP)

• The difficulty of each tab of benchmarks refers to the relative difficulty of the scenarios in them, not the skill of the players who should be playing them. Medium difficulty scenarios feature ranks stretching well into what would be exclusive to the advanced benchmarks on voltaic
• This sheet is a joint project between myself and pinguefy! Feel free to @ pingu in the Raw Input discord if you run into any issues or want to provide suggestions.
